newsitem.title: CHINA: ATHLETICS-MA'S ARMY TAKES NEW LOOK IN BEIJING RELAY.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MA'S ARMY TAKES NEW LOOK IN BEIJING RELAY.

text.p: Controversial Chinese coach Ma Junren will field three new women runners in Saturday's Beijing international relay marathon, the China News Service said on Thursday.
This year's team includes four of the seven women who won the event last year, the news service said.
Ma has been seeking to rebuild his once-formidable team, the "Ma Family Army", which took women's athletics by storm in 1993.

The team broke up the following year when several members, led by world champion Wang Junxia, mutinied over his coaching methods, which were alleged to include strict military discipline, secret turtle-blood potions, beatings and medical neglect.
Although his athletes won last year's Beijing international relay marathon, none reached China's 1996 Olympic team.
